summary: Comprehensive multi-layered test suite covering all requirements. Unit tests (8 cycles) validate parsing, classification, reporting, and CLI. Workflow structure tests verify YAML, triggers, permissions, and actionlint. End-to-end harness (run_act_tests.py) runs 3 scenarios through act, verifying exact output. All major features tested: manifest parsing (JSON/TXT), license classification, error handling, report formatting, mocked license lookup, workflow structure, and CI/CD integration. Edge cases well-covered (version ranges, case-insensitivity, deny precedence, missing files, format errors) but some boundaries missing (empty dependencies, malformed config files, file permission errors). Design is well-organized with clear TDD cycles, good fixture quality, and test independence; minor opportunities for parametrization. Would catch most regressions effectively through layered testing (unit → CLI → workflow → act).
